title: Associate Product Designer - Furniture and Lighting
note: Owned-brand furniture, lighting and outdoor living for Target, with a Back-to-College focus; asks for 2+ years of product design experience.

facts.duties: Concept and develop home products from trend research to launch; sketches, CAD models, renderings, material and finish choices; work with merchandising, sourcing and engineering.
facts.requirements: Four-year degree in industrial or product design (or equivalent); 2+ years of product design experience; Adobe Creative Suite plus Rhino or SolidWorks; portfolio.
facts.apply: Apply on Target's Workday careers site, requisition R0000480769.
